children: Yext, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $111.1M and diluted EPS of $0.13, as net income declined to $13.15M from $26.75M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “income per share attributable to common stockholders, diluted”.
Revenue trend: Quarterly and year-to-date revenue declined about 2% year-over-year, primarily due to customer attrition despite a stable subscription mix.
Customer retention & ARR: Total ARR modestly declined by 1%; net retention was 96% overall but weaker at 79% for small customers.
Cost and efficiency: Operating expenses were reduced through headcount cuts and lower personnel costs, notably in sales and R&D.
Product and channel: The platform expanded Publisher Network integrations (including Google, Apple and OpenAI), supporting Listings, Search and Pages products.
Operations: Completed strategic acquisitions (GoShine AI, Places Scout) and executed share repurchases while maintaining liquidity to fund operations.
